Modeled annual heat capacity is summed from the workbook's MWh output for 1,081 included facilities out of 2,376 records. The workbook applies its seasonal temperature-difference assumptions and 90% efficiency. Household equivalents are summed from the workbook's per-facility estimates. These are modeled estimates, not metered values.
